title: ViabilityAssessmentItems
description: Shape of content.items for L1-vision-viability-scorer. items carries META POINTS about viability-assessment.md, not the full document — the consolidated narrative across idea-brief.md, market-analysis.md and regulatory-feasibility.md lives ONLY in the artifact, saved to blob storage. viability_score is the number qg-L1-viability-score thresholds and L1-vision-statement-generator receives as an input parameter; that agent is forbidden from computing it. final_score is the weighted score after every qualifying cap is applied as a ceiling — a cap is never averaged in. A Red constraint or a requires_legal_review flag always caps the score below the threshold of 7, so an unresolved regulatory blocker cannot be outvoted by a strong market case.

viability_score.description: The final score, one decimal place, equal to score_derivation.final_score. Never rounded up across the threshold — 6.95 is reported as 6.9

recommendation.description: A statement of where the score falls against the threshold, not a decision — the workflow decides on auto-publish

final_score.description: The lowest of weighted_score and every cap that fired

capped.description: true when final_score < weighted_score — the gap stays visible, never hidden

caps_applied.description: Empty when the weighted score stands. Each entry records a ceiling that fired and what triggered it

inputs_read.description: One entry per source document, recording whether it came from an upload or blob storage

score.description: null only when the source document was absent — the missing-input cap then applies

confidence.description: Lowered, not the score, when a source document is thin — thinness is a confidence problem, not a viability problem

traced_to.description: Source document plus the ids or sections behind the score (e.g. 'regulatory-feasibility.md CON-01, CON-03') — references, not prose

reasoning.description: <=40 words. Full rationale is in viability-assessment.md

rule.description: red_constraint and regulatory_overall_red cap at 6.0; requires_legal_review at 6.5; missing_market_analysis at 6.9 — all below the threshold of 7

triggered_by.description: The CON-NN ids, or the document name for a missing-input cap

source.description: null when the document was absent. An upload is preferred over a blob copy when both exist

allOf.description: A fired cap must be reflected in the final score
Recommendation must agree with the score it reports on
